Folks —

Preliminary technical summary (high level):
- Root cause: a regression in the autoscaler heuristics introduced in release 2027.9.8 that incorrectly grouped warm-start batches, leading to excessive KV cache misses and serialized scheduling on our pooling layer between 2027-09-11T22:00Z and 2027-09-12T03:45Z.
- Impact: p95 latency elevated ~2.3x for affected routes; throughput reduced ~35%; error-rate spike tied to request queueing timeouts.
- Immediate mitigation applied: rollback of the autoscaler changes at 2027-09-12T02:10Z and a temporary conservative batch-size cap. Observed partial recovery by 2027-09-12T03:15Z; normal throughput restored by 2027-09-12T04:30Z after additional cache priming.

Next steps and ETA:
- Patch: implement deterministic batching fix + additional unit tests by 2027-09-14EOD.
- Hardening: add regression guardrails to autoscaler and extend canary window to 72 hours for autoscaler changes — planned by 2027-09-18.
- Postmortem & RCA: full report and remediation artifacts by 2027-09-15 17:00 PDT (attached notes).

Attachments: neha_kapoor_root_cause_notes.txt; redwood_remediation_plan_v1.docx

I'll present these findings on the exec call and include the precise incident window for SLA calculation.

—Neha Kapoor
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Olivia

1) Commercial remedy (draft):
- Measured availability shortfall: 3.6% over the incident window (per routed request counts).
- Proposed credit: pro-rated service-credit equal to 3.6% of billable usage during the incident week + a one-time goodwill credit equal to 12% of that week's spend (total = 15.6% of one-week usage). Maximum cap: $150,000.
- Payment/document flow: Redwood to send a contract amendment and DocuSign link for acceptance. Credit applied as account balance or offset on next invoice per your preference.

2) Operational controls to be added to SOW (draft):
- Mandatory 72-hour canary for autoscaler releases affecting production batching/kv-cache logic.
- Pre-deploy regression tests for batching heuristics and a rollback runbook with 15-minute restoration RTO targets.

3) Technical remediation and governance:
- Patch delivery: deterministic batching fix by 2027-09-14EOD (completed; see attachment).
- Postmortem: RCA + instrumentation changes and test artifacts attached. Full RCA will be posted to the shared Drive folder.
- Exec POC: Stephanie Nguyen (commercial) + Neha Kapoor (technical). Vivek will be technical escalation for any contract exceptions.

Attachments: redwood_remediation_plan_v1.docx; neha_kapoor_root_cause_notes.txt
